name: malakim_horseman
description: a Malakim Horseman, a desert rider with a long white beard and dark skin, a cream turban with a teal band and a gold jewel, flowing cream robes with a teal sash and brown boots, a round bronze shield with a teal rim and a gold boss on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped wooden spear in his LEFT hand, riding a palomino horse with a cream mane and tail, a brown bridle and a teal saddle cloth hung with gold tassels
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round bronze shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
